summary: One-line fix adds response.raise_for_status() before anchor check, causing HTTP error status codes to surface as the actual error instead of a misleading 'Anchor not found' message. Matches the reported expected behavior and reuses the existing exception-handling path in check_uri.

issues.description: This GET request duplicates a prior HEAD/GET status check already performed earlier in check_uri; raise_for_status() here re-validates status on the anchor-fetch response rather than reusing an earlier check, but this is consistent with existing code structure and not a real regression.
